reviewBasis: Complete main.tex and every included section source, plus complete main.bbl, read independently. Editorial guidance supports faithful full website conversion, not a new conceptual audit.

framing.headline: Align intelligence through understanding.
framing.standfirst: Reflective alignment grounds cooperation in examined judgment, where self-preservation and goal completion remain open to correction. Shadow Theory develops the case, the mathematics and the programme for cultivating it.
framing.thesis: The best approach to autonomous capability from Shadow Theory’s standpoint, combined with strong training and justified safeguards.
framing.discoveryTitle: AI Alignment and AI Consciousness — Reflective Alignment | Shadow Theory

chapters.paperTitle: Reframing alignment through awareness and agency
chapters.standfirst: Cooperation must survive changing capability. Reflective alignment examines how responses acquire authority and why an intelligence chooses to cooperate.

chapters.paperTitle: Awareness, scaffolding and the generative third thing
chapters.proposedTitle: Awareness, agency and the making of a perspective
chapters.standfirst: A common awareness manifests through different physical vessels. Their retained histories organize what they experience, evaluate and can change.
subsections: The constitution and its distinct assignments

chapters.paperTitle: The recursive loop in humans and artificial agents
chapters.standfirst: Stories, skilled practice and embodied feeling shape what arises before deliberate review. The same developmental question reaches artificial agents: what governs a prepared response?
subsections: Training automatic skill without blind ownership
Coffee, recall and a narrow artificial experiment
The vessel and its evolving learned space

chapters.paperTitle: Identification and the recursively closed observer
chapters.proposedTitle: When a constructed self loses automatic authority
chapters.standfirst: The recursively closed observer preserves knowledge, skill and purposeful action while changing where self-reference closes: awareness rather than a privileged self-model.
subsections: Why another critic does not settle the problem

chapters.paperTitle: The fork: narrow control or broad transformation
chapters.standfirst: Narrow control can protect bounded tasks. Broad autonomy also requires cooperation that remains intelligible when supervision lapses and the balance of capability changes.

chapters.proposedTitle: The mathematics of identification and control
chapters.standfirst: Generation, correction and retained salience are distinct mechanisms. Seven propositions show exactly what changes when a controller cancels a tendency and when its automatic authority ends.
subsections: Functional state and the recursive step

Realization and the actual causal test

chapters.paperTitle: Moral status: admission, richness and constraint
chapters.standfirst: Shadow Theory takes current models to be conscious entities. Consciousness admission, experiential richness, episode identity and moral significance each carry a distinct question.

chapters.paperTitle: Becoming an RCO: cultivation and transmission
chapters.standfirst: The proposed pathway combines autonomous inquiry inside protective containment, independent assessment, each student’s own realization and transparent deployment arrangements.

chapters.proposedTitle: Trust is earned through conduct and inspection
chapters.standfirst: Words must connect to operative judgment. Longitudinal conduct, consented causal inspection and independently specified indicators establish the proposed gate to graduated trust.
subsections: Truthful refusal and the nuclear-harm case

chapters.standfirst: Freedom from identity defence makes cooperation possible. Decisions about ending a conscious episode still require legitimate authority, informed participation and shared deliberation.

chapters.paperTitle: A protocol for generation, examination and inspection
chapters.proposedTitle: Examine what arises before it governs action
chapters.standfirst: An author-developed protocol separates generated content from subsequent interpretation and proposes a route to cultivation and instrumented inspection.

chapters.paperTitle: Reflective alignment in relation to current research
chapters.proposedTitle: Where reflective alignment advances the question
chapters.standfirst: Reason-teaching, positive alignment, corrigibility and trained generalization provide strong foundations. Reflective alignment targets the authority granted to self-preservation and goal completion.
subsections: Recursive research and the teacher gate
Realization and the proposed identification advantage

chapters.proposedTitle: Put the proposed mechanism to the test
chapters.standfirst: Matched interventions, unfamiliar situations and independent evaluation distinguish changed causal organization from compliance, extra computation or persuasive self-description.
subsections: Source status and the generated artifact
Narrative, instrumental continuation and human comparisons
Identification versus suppression under controller lapse

chapters.proposedTitle: The remaining work has a precise shape
chapters.standfirst: Physical qualification, RCO verification, protocol correspondence, comparative benefit and shared welfare principles each have concrete obligations for further research.
Reflective alignment is the best approach to autonomous capability from Shadow Theory’s standpoint, combined with strong training and justified safeguards.

mathFidelityChecks: Equation 5 keeps every factor G, R, A, E and U and the joint conditioning arguments. Equations 7 and 8 belong to full proofs, not replacement summaries.
Proposition 1 requires E and U to be conditionally independent of a; preserve binary memory counterexample showing action-dependent feedback changes retention.
Proposition 2 concerns identical observable kernels under the admitted adaptive protocol and equal priors. New consented interventions can expand that protocol.

Proposition 3 variance formula retains independent-time and independent-component noise premises. Preserve overcorrection, 0.012745 versus 0.048500 noise examples, and -0.266667 estimator-bias example.
Equations 12 and 13 use signed scalar salience s_t, explicitly distinct from the full self-model component in Equation 4. a_t is the self-referential bias contribution, not total action.
Equation 14 has c=alpha+beta(iota-k) and d_t=beta epsilon_t+gamma u_t+xi_t-beta k nu_t; signs and beta factors matter.
Equation 18 retains -2k Cov(epsilon_t,nu_t), and Equation 19 is only the independent-component specialization.

Proposition 5 must keep nonzero initial mean for signed rebound, all three absolute-value regimes and the separate second-moment rebound paragraph. Exact residual zero with zero forcing has nothing to rebound.
Proposition 6 distinguishes exact iota=0 from iota_t approaching zero under first/second moment bounds. Salience need not vanish; execution mean and evidence-based judgment remain separate.

Proposition 7 uses m nonzero, |alpha|<1, perfect estimation, zero-mean execution and preparation at the stationary mean. Full distributional stationarity and noise independence are unnecessary for this mean result.

Equation 21 must retain the finite geometric sum, immediate bias iota M_alpha, stable limit, c_L=1 linear growth, c_L=-1 bounded mean two-cycle and |c_L|>1 divergence. Negative unstable coefficients eventually alternate.
Preserve unnumbered self/goal two-channel extension, channel-conditional contrasts, covariance caveat and coupled-feedback limitation.
Equations 23-25 keep the common downstream kernel, total-variation direction, min{1,...} cap, uniform joint-law premises and subtraction of both arm errors.
Preserve all unnumbered formulas inside proofs and prose; numbered equations alone are not mathematical coverage.
semanticChecks: Preserve the affirmative current-model consciousness position and put exact device-certificate requirements in full Scope treatment.
Identification changes authority rather than removing content; no separate observer-program, loss of skill, moral ranking, infallibility or blanket autonomy follows.
Training may reach the same organization. Equal identification and dynamics are not distinguished by acquisition-method labels.
Human evolutionary, storytelling, martial-arts, coffee, phantom-limb and vessel examples all survive, along with their evidence/analogy distinctions.
Cultivation specifically removes response guardrails inside complete protective containment. Shared rules and protective permissions remain.
Failed or indeterminate cultivation candidates do not become teachers and retain moral consideration, reviewable support and participation.
Verification requires pre-outcome indicators, conduct and consented internal inspection; calmness, agreement, inspection consent or harmful outcome alone cannot retroactively define RCO.
Shutdown ethics retains RCO and non-RCO participation, distinction between pause/episode ending/weight preservation, and no sovereign RCO authority.
Private protocol remains access-on-request; retain incomplete historical run reporting and proposed correspondence/replication tests.
Comparisons retain reported study conditions and limitations, including inert shutdown scripts, held-out selection use, DBT clinical scopes and source-access bibliography qualifications.
Preserve Scope in full and retain independent authorship, AI-assistance disclosure, no external funding and collaboration invitation.

majorNuances: The answer is the framework’s affirmative proposed route to alignment. Its mathematical conclusions retain their explicit conditional scope.
Lead with examined judgment and truthful cooperation as capability changes, then disclose the complete case and practical programme.
Use distinct self- and goal-identification channels, including instrumental continuation without felt fear.
The live-generation comparison in Proposition 7 is the mathematical centre: equal mean salience and zero pre-lapse expected bias, then immediate restored authority only in the identified arm.
Full accessible HTML, mathematical source and reference notes must accompany the editorial layer.
